market_summary: US100 displays strong bullish momentum above VAH and VWAP during New York session, supported by positive CVD pressure. FX majors (EURUSD, GBPUSD) and XAUUSD remain heavily depressed under VWAP, but are stretched into short-term support/lower ATR bands, warranting patience. BTCUSD is testing session highs above VAH but lacks volume and CVD confirmation.

Price is extended directly near Session Low (1.10824) without immediate pullback entry.

The divergence between bearish structural trend and strong positive CVD slope inside VA indicates chop/rebound towards mean.

Price is operating above VAH (28299.47) and well above POC (28263.55). CVD is +11.73 (BULLISH) with positive slope (+3.42) in NEW_YORK_SESSION, strongly supporting buyers. Price is comfortably above VWAP (28153.31) and EMA50 (28199.53), expanding beyond upper ATR band (28438.94). Dukascopy tick volume caveat applies (RVOL yellow spikes rare on US100), but structure and CVD are aligned for upside momentum.

Price is above VAH (73920.85) and above POC (73650.62). CVD is -0.06 (BEARISH / near zero divergence) in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is cleanly above VWAP (73703.48) and EMA50 (73751.00), approaching upper ATR band (74413.17) and Session High (74384.10). Absence of RVOL confirmation (rvol_last 1.279, no spikes) combined with flat/bearish CVD suggests potential overhead resistance trap at 74384 high.
